source: A toy of the mechanism's own equations. No model, no weights and no recorded measurement: the numbers on screen are computed in the page from the parameters below.
equations: Atom k sits at p_k on a golden spiral. Every atom is a source and a listener.
A write by atom j leaves, in each wave pattern m, a trace with phase kappa_m . p_j. A listener k reads it back with phase kappa_m . p_k.

Summed over the patterns, the read is the mean of cos(kappa_m . (p_k - p_j)). With wavevectors drawn at random this approaches a Gaussian of the distance between the two atoms. The ear width sets its width.
Time is a bank of damped oscillators. Each bell fades at its own rate, so fast bells carry the recent past and slow bells ring on.
